Name: oldWPCond
Desc:
Restore logic to give +5 WP upon clearing
a Bonus Condition for a chapter, instead of giving
10000 Points.
Regardless, clearing the stage will give
a base result of +10 WP with this mod enabled.

If Game Overs are restored, no WP will be gained
upon completing a chapter if it has been replayed
after at least 1 Game Over.



Set the Active field to "true" for the
Restore_WPMessage addOn in data5-4/Data_Text
to correct the Bonus Condition clear message.
